hooks.command:
f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty"); { [ -z "$f" ] || [ ! -f "$f" ]; } && exit 0
case "$f" in */generated/*) exit 0;; esac
npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1
case "$f" in
  */apps/*/src/*.ts|*/apps/*/src/*.tsx|*/apps/*/test/*.ts|*/apps/*/scripts/*.ts|*/packages/*/src/*.ts|*/packages/*/src/*.tsx)
    out=$( (cd "$(dirname "$f")" && npx eslint --fix "$f") 2>&1 ) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
    ;;
esac
exit 0
